As per your request, please find the 6-month rates for Upper Crest - Downtown below:

August: AED 7,500
September: AED 8,500
October: AED 10,500
November: AED 14,500
December: AED 16,500
January: AED 14,500

Please note that a security deposit of AED 3,000 is required.

The booking will be arranged on a monthly basis only (30 nights per booking).

Should you require any further assistance, please feel free to let us know.
